note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely declared: dated customs/B-L records with destination (Germany; group entity also USA, Japan, China), HS codes and B/L numbers exist, and the observed HS 40092100/40093100 matches the declared 400921;400931 (the older 400200 rows are a legacy 6-digit classification of the same braided hose product, not a mismatch requiring correction). Domestic supply evidence is null/unknown — not asserted, because no GST turnover, tender or contract source was reachable; this is a data-access gap, not a finding of no domestic supply.
